title: Crash on incompatible dictionary unpack
body:
Type checking this code fragment causes a mypy crash:

```py
from typing import Dict

def f() -> Dict[int, str]:
    return {1: '', **d()}

def d() -> Dict[int, int]:
    return {}
```
